raw_text: {"thesis":"Prioritise one bounded organic test around pressure-washer equipment, then address choice clarity and destination mapping in car drying, contact washing and wheel cleaning. Pre-wash ranks first because it has the strongest cleaned non-branded click signal: the 365-day baseline recorded 8 clicks from 217 impressions, while the latest 90-day trend recorded 6 clicks from 180 impressions versus 2 clicks from 21 impressions in the prior 90 days. This is search visibility and engagement evidence, not proof of commercial traction; every intervention should therefore be measured against product-level conversion and sales before wider investment.","recommendations":[{"opportunity_id":"opportunity-prewash_pressure","priority":1,"canonical_product_names":["Stubby Gun & Nozzle Set","Snow Foam Lance","Stubby Gun + Foam Lance Bundle"],"target_url":"https://streetkingz.co.uk/product/stubby-gun-and-nozzle-set/","customer_job":"Choose a compact pressure-washer gun, understand the included nozzles and find the appropriate snow-foam setup.","intervention":"Run a bounded on-page test for Stubby Gun & Nozzle Set. Align the title, opening copy and FAQ with cleaned phrases such as “stubby pressure washer gun” and “stubby gun nozzles”; publish only verified connection and compatibility details. Add prominent contextual links to Snow Foam Lance and Stubby Gun + Foam Lance Bundle so combined gun-and-foam intent reaches the correct products. Measure page-level Search Console clicks and CTR separately from product conversion over the next comparable 90-day window.","why_prioritised":"The 365-day baseline has 8 clicks from 217 impressions, the strongest cleaned click count relative to visibility among the opportunities. Separately, the latest 90-day trend rose to 6 clicks from 180 impressions from 2 clicks and 21 impressions in the prior 90 days. The current page title and description are generic about build quality, while the cleaned queries repeatedly specify pressure-washer use, nozzles and foam-cannon combinations.","evidence_ids":["gsc:prewash_pressure","serp:prewash_pressure","destination:prewash_pressure"],"confidence":"medium-low","missing_evidence":["product-level sales and conversion by landing page","stock availability","margin/COGS","verified pressure-washer connection and compatibility specifications","query-level position and CTR by destination"],"what_could_make_it_wrong":"The 90-day increase may be temporary, and the query set mixes gun-only, snow-foam and general pre-wash intent. If compatibility is narrow, stock is constrained or the clicks do not convert, this should remain a small SEO test rather than a broader investment."},{"opportunity_id":"opportunity-car_drying","priority":2,"canonical_product_names":["XL DRYING TOWEL – 800GSM","Heavy Duty Drying Towel – 1200gsm"],"target_url":"https://streetkingz.co.uk/product/xl-drying-towel-800gsm/","customer_job":"Choose the appropriate car drying towel and understand the practical difference between the 800GSM and 1200gsm options.","intervention":"Add a concise, verified comparison module to XL DRYING TOWEL – 800GSM that explains when to choose it versus Heavy Duty Drying Towel – 1200gsm, with a descriptive internal link to the latter. Use verified specifications only and answer the SERP-supported questions about towel type, suitability and value. Preserve the existing substantial page rather than commissioning a new destination, then measure query-level CTR and product conversion for a separate 90-day period.","why_prioritised":"Car drying has the largest cleaned baseline visibility at 3,328 impressions but only 2 clicks. Separately, latest-90-day impressions were 1,671 versus 1,307 in the prior 90 days, while clicks remained flat at 1 in each period. The SERP contains product listings and questions about the best towel type, while the current XL product page does not show a contextual link to Heavy Duty Drying Towel – 1200gsm. This supports a choice-clarity test, not a full rewrite.","evidence_ids":["gsc:car_drying","serp:car_drying","destination:car_drying"],"confidence":"low","missing_evidence":["product-level sales and conversion","stock availability for both towels","margin/COGS","verified comparative dimensions, construction and drying-capacity specifications","page-and-query-level average position"],"what_could_make_it_wrong":"Low clicks may primarily reflect weak rankings or shopping-heavy SERPs rather than comparison friction. A comparison module will have limited value if the products have little commercial demand, unavailable stock or insufficient verified differentiation."},{"opportunity_id":"opportunity-contact_washing","priority":3,"canonical_product_names":["Microfibre Wash Mitt","The Origin Shampoo – Ultra Concentrated & pH Safe","Origin Wash Kit"],"target_url":"https://streetkingz.co.uk/product/microfibre-wash-mitt/","customer_job":"Find a scratch-safe wash mitt and move easily between the mitt, compatible shampoo and a combined wash kit.","intervention":"Prioritise internal-link hygiene rather than a broad copy rewrite. Audit the Microfibre Wash Mitt link currently pointing to the non-registry shampoo path and replace or canonicalise it to https://streetkingz.co.uk/product/origin-shampoo/. Add descriptive reciprocal links among Microfibre Wash Mitt, The Origin Shampoo – Ultra Concentrated & pH Safe and Origin Wash Kit. Preserve the already aligned wash-mitt title and substantial content, then monitor clicks and conversion over the next comparable 90-day window.","why_prioritised":"The 365-day baseline recorded 6 clicks from 2,196 impressions. Separately, the latest 90 days produced 0 clicks from 1,101 impressions versus 4 clicks from 743 impressions in the prior 90 days. The destination is already substantial and closely aligned to wash-mitt intent, so a large rewrite is not supported. The destination evidence does show an internal shampoo href that differs from the canonical catalogue URL, creating a bounded technical and navigational intervention.","evidence_ids":["gsc:contact_washing","serp:contact_washing","destination:contact_washing"],"confidence":"low","missing_evidence":["redirect and canonical status of the non-registry shampoo URL","product-level sales and conversion","stock availability","margin/COGS","query-level position and landing-page distribution"],"what_could_make_it_wrong":"The non-registry href may already redirect cleanly and therefore have little impact. The click decline could instead come from ranking changes, SERP shopping features or broad kit queries that are not well served by a single mitt product."},{"opportunity_id":"opportunity-wheel_cleaning","priority":4,"canonical_product_names":["The XL Barrel Brush","Slim Barrel Brush","Wheel Belt Flosser","Wheel Cleaning Kit (XL Brush + Slim Brush + Belt Flosser)"],"target_url":"https://streetkingz.co.uk/product/the-xl-barrel-brush/","customer_job":"Choose the correct brush or flosser for cleaning wheel barrels and tight wheel spaces.","intervention":"Defer broad wheel-content expansion and first correct intent-to-destination mapping. Route barrel-brush anchors and relevant merchandising links to The XL Barrel Brush, keep Wheel Belt Flosser focused on flosser-specific use, and link both products to Wheel Cleaning Kit (XL Brush + Slim Brush + Belt Flosser). Do not force the predominantly barrel-brush query set onto the flosser page. Reassess after a separate 90-day measurement window.","why_prioritised":"The cleaned wheel queries are dominated by “wheel barrel brush”, “alloy wheel barrel brush” and tight-space brush variants, while the packet's initial opportunity destination is Wheel Belt Flosser. The 365-day baseline is small at 1 click from 199 impressions. Separately, the latest 90 days had 1 click from 57 impressions versus 0 clicks from 97 impressions in the prior 90 days. Correct mapping is justified, but the limited scale does not support a large content build.","evidence_ids":["gsc:wheel_cleaning","serp:wheel_cleaning","destination:wheel_cleaning"],"confidence":"low","missing_evidence":["page-level query allocation across wheel products","product-level sales and conversion","stock availability","margin/COGS","verified brush-size and wheel-gap suitability specifications"],"what_could_make_it_wrong":"Google may already be selecting The XL Barrel Brush for most barrel-brush queries, making internal remapping incremental. The low impression volume may also be too small to produce a measurable commercial return."}],"winner_comparison":[{"alternative_opportunity_id":"opportunity-car_drying","why_credible":"It has the largest cleaned 365-day visibility at 3,328 impressions, and latest-90-day impressions were higher than the prior 90-day window. The catalogue also has two clearly differentiated GSM variants that can support a comparison intervention.","why_lost":"The baseline generated only 2 clicks, and clicks remained at 1 in each 90-day window. The current destination is already substantial and well aligned, while the SERP is crowded with product features and established retailers. There is no conversion evidence showing that the greater visibility has commercial value.","what_could_change_result":"Verified strong towel conversion, healthy margins and stock, or query-level evidence of near-page-one rankings with unusually weak CTR would move car drying above pre-wash."},{"alternative_opportunity_id":"opportunity-contact_washing","why_credible":"Its 365-day baseline has 2,196 impressions and 6 clicks, and the catalogue supports single-product and kit destinations. The SERP clearly reflects product-shopping and comparison intent.","why_lost":"The latest 90-day window fell to 0 clicks despite 1,101 impressions, versus 4 clicks from 743 impressions previously. The destination is already well aligned, so the packet supports diagnosis and link hygiene more strongly than immediate content investment.","what_could_change_result":"Evidence that the click loss came from a correctable technical issue, combined with strong product conversion, available stock and favourable margins, would raise its priority."},{"alternative_opportunity_id":"opportunity-wheel_cleaning","why_credible":"The queries are product-specific and expose a correctable mismatch between barrel-brush intent and the initially selected flosser destination. The catalogue has individual brushes and a complete kit that can be linked coherently.","why_lost":"The 365-day baseline is only 199 impressions and 1 click, and the latest 90-day window has just 57 impressions. That scale is materially weaker than the pre-wash signal and does not justify broad investment without sales evidence.","what_could_change_result":"Higher page-level visibility for The XL Barrel Brush, demonstrated conversion for wheel products, or evidence that destination remapping unlocks a larger relevant query set would improve its ranking."}],"limitations":["No cleaned third-party keyword-volume evidence is available for any opportunity; all keyword_evidence arrays are empty.","Sales, product-level conversion, stock movement and margin/COGS are missing, so Search Console visibility and clicks are not treated as commercial traction.","The 365-day figures are used only as baselines. Latest and prior 90-day windows are treated as separate trends and are not added to the baseline or to each other.","The aggregated Search Console evidence does not provide page-level average position, device mix or conversion attribution, limiting diagnosis of low CTR and click changes.","SERP evidence is a single retrieval snapshot and may change; it supports format and intent observations but not durable demand estimates.","Glass cleaning, interior cleaning, microfibre application and accessories were not recommended because their cleaned Search Console evidence is negligible or absent, and no commercial evidence offsets that uncertainty.","Rejected branded, navigational, unsupported-catalogue and destination-mismatched evidence was not used."]}
